g.text: Lookahead labels vs selecting on observed outcomes, as the draw split varies
A. Invalid draws count as failures

Teacher conditions see only draw 0, so the split only changes which draws score them. Bars: 95% task-clustered bootstrap. New states are only ones whose candidates' outcomes differ, so their rates are lower.
